_readme.colors: Key = normalised literal: #RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA uppercase (3/4-digit hex expanded, alpha FF dropped), or rgba(r, g, b, a) with one space after commas (rgb()/alpha 1 → hex). palette = key in src/foundations/palette.ts; paletteVar = its CSS var; semantic = --nk-color-* tokens with the exact same value (pick the one that matches the meaning; cssVar = first semantic, else the palette var).
_readme.type: Key = "<weight> <size>px/<line>[px]" from a font shorthand ending in var(--nk-font-family). token = key in tokens.type → font: var(--nk-type-<kebab>). token null = one-off: keep, or add a flow-scoped type token in the flow tokens.ts (TokenOverrides.type).
_readme.fontSize: Key = "<n>px" font size → var(--nk-font-size-<kebab>) (tokens.fontSize). Prefer a whole var(--nk-type-*) shorthand (see type) when weight and line height match too.
